# QR Code generator 1.8.0

Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/cpp

The original C++ `qrcodegen.hpp` and `qrcodegen.cpp` are included unchanged from
release `v1.8.0`. Their MIT license and copyright notices are embedded in each
source file. The display node uses the library to encode the official NetEase
login URL locally; account tokens are not part of the display message.
